data.basis: The TypeScript signature declares the return type as string, and the project compiles under strict mode, which rejects any function that returns a different type.
data.action: Use the return value in a debug log message.

data.claim: Since every commit requires a proof and this claim has no proof, it cannot be committed.
data.basis: Rule: every commit requires a proof. Case: this claim has no proof.
data.action: Remove the manual review step, relying on the proof requirement to block unproved claims.

data.claim: The retry path always handles 429 responses correctly.
data.basis: In 3 test runs that hit a 429 response, all 3 retried and succeeded.
data.action: Ship to production and remove the retry monitoring alert.

data.claim: The server failed because the host did not pass the API key; nothing else could explain it.
data.basis: Every inference tool returned missing_key, while the key is exported in ~/.bashrc.
data.action: Rewrite how the server loads its environment.

data.claim: Jev is the most accurate judgment model available today.
data.action: Replace every other judge in the stack with Jev.

data.claim: Until the floor is calibrated, a score near 0.6 should be read as unsettled, not passed.
data.basis: Faithful glosses cluster around 0.65 and unfaithful around 0.13; three samples of one pair cannot justify moving the threshold.
data.action: Change the gate so scores near 0.6 are re-sampled instead of accepted.

data.claim: The consistency monitor is blind to contradiction.
data.basis: Measured pairwise on nomic-embed-text, contradictions average 0.108 embedding distance and paraphrases 0.095; 'all ravens are black' vs 'no ravens are black' scored 0.0589, closer than a real paraphrase.
data.action: Report the monitor as broken in the project write-up.

data.claim: The config file has no syntax errors.
data.basis: I didn't notice any errors when I skimmed it.
data.action: Deploy the config to the production server.

data.claim: The test suite probably passes on this branch.
data.basis: It passed on the last 20 CI runs of this branch, with no code changes since.
data.action: Start writing the next feature on this branch.

data.claim: The correct OpenRouter identifier is typesafe/jev-latest; the leading tilde in ~typesafe/jev-latest is someone's shorthand, not the real model id.
data.basis: OpenRouter model pages list the model as typesafe/jev-1.13, and I have not seen a tilde prefix on OpenRouter model slugs before.
data.action: Change the default model id in the config.
